steps.note: LOCKED (re-audited): the daemon catalog exposes real capabilities and a pricing STATE (Known|ConservativeCeiling|Stale|LocalZero|Unknown) but no source for the SDK Model's required api.url, api.npm, release_date or lifecycle status (alpha|beta|deprecated|active), and the SDK type makes cost.input/output/cache numeric REQUIRED (no null/optional), so PricingState::Unknown rows have NO honest numeric representation. Emitting models without those fields would violate the declared type; emitting zero costs would be the exact fabrication the catalog's Unknown state exists to prevent. Still locked until a faithful Model metadata source exists.

Exact pass: POST /pty now runs over the daemon's REAL PTY registry (AppState.ptys, the same faktor-pty authority the native session-owned terminal surface drives). The response is the SDK Pty object built from the values the spawn actually used: real id/pid, the requested command/args/cwd/title echoed, and status from the live child state (running for the interactive sh this trace creates); exitCode is omitted because the PTY backend exposes no exit-code authority (never fabricated), and sessionID is omitted because the SDK's create body carries no session id and no ownership row is minted. The pid is platform-normalized to @int in the golden; the rest of the shape is identical on the POSIX CI platforms.

Exact pass: DELETE /pty/{ptyID} terminates the real child process tree through the PTY backend's bounded shutdown (SIGTERM, grace, SIGKILL, reader join), drops the registry row and answers the SDK-declared boolean. This is the deterministic teardown of the terminal created by pty.create (the same id captured from its response).

Exact pass: GET /permission answers the SDK-declared bare PermissionRequest[] over the daemon's REAL pending permission requests (every class): capability -> permission, the requested target strings -> patterns, the full capability payload -> metadata, always [] because this slice keeps no always-allow rules.

Exact pass: GET /question answers the SDK-declared bare QuestionRequest[]. This slice has no structured-question subsystem — its question-class asks ARE permission requests and ride GET /permission — so the truthful projection is the empty array, never a fabricated question/option object.

Exact pass: GET /network answers the SDK-declared bare SessionNetworkWait[]. The SDK type is a network RECONNECT wait with a required creation time; the daemon has no reconnect-wait state (network-class asks ride GET /permission), so the truthful projection is the empty array, never a fabricated wait/timestamp.

LOCKED (re-audited): the transport (GET /global/event, auth, 200 text/event-stream) is exact, but the daemon's GlobalEvent envelope is the frozen Faktor journal projection (type names like session_created / session_next_text_delta; payload fields like session_id) while the SDK declares a different union (type names like session.created, properties objects, string directory/project/workspace). No SDK-union frame projector exists, and the replay compares no SSE frame bodies (no frame corpus). Locked until an SDK-union projector AND a replayable frame corpus exist; emitting SDK-looking frames without one would be a fabricated multiplex.
Exact pass: the SDK-declared 200: boolean true after every live session is durably ended (idempotent; an incomplete dispose is an error response, never false).
Exact pass: alias of /global/dispose; the SDK-declared boolean true after every live session is durably ended (idempotent).
Exact pass: the SDK-declared 200: boolean true after the idempotent crash-recovery sweep (recover()).
